top_signals.title: South Africa Set to Lift Sugar-Benchmark Price to Shield Growers
top_signals.summary: South Africa will raise the benchmark price that’s used to calculate duties on sugar imports, a move long-sought by domestic producers like Associated British Foods Plc’s local unit in an industry that’s been battered by cheap foreign competition, according to people familiar with the matter.
